lines.2: 「If you're eating at the university cafeteria, this is the place to do it. Makes the food taste even better.」
lines.3: The cafeteria offered a panoramic view of the ocean.
lines.4: That was one of the signature features of Ryuumeikan's 'university cafeteria.'
lines.5: The school cafeteria was already famous for its good food, and then it had a facility like this. No wonder the students loved it. (There were plenty of ordinary seats inside the building too.)
lines.6: The third-years studying on the first floor had the easiest time getting these seats, while the first-years on the third floor had the farthest to go. You could call it seniority in action.
lines.7: 「Still... island exile, huh? The only thing that needs releasing is my sex drive.」
lines.8: 「Yeah. Keep talking like that and you'll be the one they ship off to that island.」
lines.9: The island clearly visible from here was an uninhabited island owned by our school: Squid Island.
lines.10: As Miss Inori had said, students with poor grades or bad behavior were sent there.
lines.11: There, their character was reformed through a program called 'island exile.'
lines.12: Alongside the university cafeteria, it was one of Ryuumeikan's famous institutions.
lines.13: 「Heh... Bring it on. Island exile? Me? Nobody gets to color my soul!」
lines.14: A student who had said that came back from island exile like this:
lines.15: 「I was mistaken. I take pride in having been admitted to the great Ryuumeikan Academy, and I intend to be of whatever service I can to this school. I fear nothing.」
lines.16: In other words, he had become a 'good, obedient child.'
lines.17: One example like that was enough to make island exile a symbol of terror.
lines.18: Though you had to do something pretty serious to actually get sent there.
lines.19: Fukahire ate while watching the girls.
lines.20: When the sea breeze blew hard, this became a prime panty-shot spot.
lines.21: Maybe they should exile him once after all.
lines.22: We had finished eating. Time for the meeting.
